headline: Executive order titled "The Gold Card," signed September 19, 2025, sets up a program by that name.
what_it_does: No summary was provided, so details here are limited to the title. The order creates or directs a program called the "Gold Card." Public reporting around its signing described it as a way for wealthy foreign nationals to pay for faster access to US immigrant visas. The exact rules, costs, and eligibility are not confirmed by the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign nationals seeking to move to the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may have a new option to apply for immigration status through the Gold Card program, depending on the order's details.
They would likely be responsible for setting up and running the program.
